candidates.screen: Workspace shell: detail screens opened from Summary, admin Lifestyle and admin Program
candidates.problem: When the selected tab has no nested navigation controller, EdgeSwipeToReturn.swift:73-84 and :101-126 call onRootSwipe (return to My Programs). AdminSummaryTab (every role), AdminWorkoutTypesTab and AdminProgramTab have no NavigationStack, so their links push onto the outer stack (e.g. AdminSummaryTab.swift:202-207). From the code, a left-edge swipe on Add workouts, Log health, timelines, Edit program or Manage roles leaves the whole program and throws away an unsaved form. Inferred from code: needs a 30-second device check (Summary → Add workouts → swipe from the left edge).
candidates.fix: In handleEdgePan, return early when the outer navigation controller's top view controller isn't the one hosting the TabView, so the native pop handles that swipe. Only return to My Programs from a real tab root.
candidates.benefit: Swipe-back goes back one screen as iOS users expect, instead of dropping a half-filled log form and leaving the program.
candidates.other_surfaces: iOS-only hack. Android uses system back (program-picker SPEC A-6) and web uses browser back.

candidates.problem: These tabs load one request after another: StandardMembersTab.swift:161-197 (up to 9), StandardWorkoutTypesTab.swift:117-137 (7), AdminWorkoutTypesTab.swift:100-106 and :135-149 (3+7), AdminMembersTab.swift:131-139 (5). The standard tabs redo this behind a full-tab spinner on every visit (.task :90 / :107). With the 15 s timeout, a connection with no internet can mean up to 90–150 s of spinner or zeros, which matches the user's 'it's just loading'. There are also duplicate fetches: StandardMembersTab.swift:175-187 fetches every member's metrics just to find its own row, then fetches that row again, and MemberCards.swift:249-253 refetches health logs the tab already loaded (AdminMembersTab.swift:138).
candidates.fix: Run each tab's independent reads at the same time (async let or a TaskGroup; they write separate ProgramContext fields). Drop the two duplicate fetches. Show the spinner only when nothing is on screen yet.
candidates.benefit: Members and Lifestyle open in one network round instead of 6–10, and a dead connection costs at most one 15 s timeout instead of minutes.
candidates.other_surfaces: Android is also sequential (MembersScreen.kt:103-110, :160-172). Web uses parallel TanStack queries with '…' placeholders (lifestyle/page.tsx:218-230).

candidates.problem: Hide, show, delete and rename failures set errorMessage (WorkoutTypesSection.swift:290, 306, 316, 326), but it only renders inside the Add sheet (:253), and opening that sheet clears it (:134). So deleting a custom type that has logs silently does nothing, even though the backend sends a clear reason ('…It has N workout logs… Consider hiding it instead.', workoutService.js:215). The edit sheet sets isSaving = true (:376) and never resets it, so after a failed rename its Save button stays disabled with no message.
candidates.fix: Show list-level errors in an alert or an inline row above the list. On a failed rename, reset the edit sheet's saving state and keep it open with the error.
candidates.benefit: Admins see why a delete or rename failed and what to do instead (hide it), rather than a button that seems broken.
candidates.other_surfaces: Web shows these errors inline (lifestyle/workouts/page.tsx:147) and so does Android (WorkoutTypesListScreen.kt:132-134). The gap is iOS-only.

candidates.problem: applySelection (AdminMembersTab.swift:123-139) switches the label to the new member at once. But the Overview, Streak, History and Workouts cards keep reading the previous member's data from shared ProgramContext fields (MemberOverviewPicker.swift:85, 105-113; MemberCards.swift:23, 46, 69-70, 136-143) until each of 5 loads lands, and forever if one fails (the loaders only set errorMessage, ProgramContext+Members.swift:116-198). The Overview card even prints the previous member's name (MemberOverviewPicker.swift:138). MemberHealthCard already blanks on switch (MemberCards.swift:249-250).
candidates.fix: Clear selectedMemberOverview, memberHistory, memberStreaks and memberRecent when the selection changes (as MemberHealthCard does), and show a placeholder until each one loads.
candidates.benefit: An admin never reads one member's streak or totals under another member's name.
candidates.other_surfaces: Web keys each query by member id, so no bleed. Android hoists the selection into ProgramContext (MembersScreen.kt:96-111) and probably has the same shared-field bleed; check it when touching Android.

candidates.screen: Log forms, member Workouts/Health detail, Program-tab management, Lifestyle/Steps timelines
candidates.problem: About 17 places in this area show error.localizedDescription, i.e. iOS system text such as 'The Internet connection appears to be offline.' or 'Request failed (500)'. Examples: AddWorkoutsDetailView.swift:463-467 (plus BulkWorkoutError.message on a 5xx), AddDailyHealthDetailView.swift:516-521, MemberRecentDetail.swift:422/824, MemberHealthDetail.swift:457/968, MemberManagementSection.swift:352/366, RoleManagementSection.swift:297, WorkoutTypesSection.swift:290-342, EditProgramInfoView.swift:223, ProgramCards.swift:92, and the timeline banners fed by ProgramContext+Analytics.swift:115-117. Screens that adopted the kit already use its messages (InviteMemberView.swift:160, InvitesTabView.swift:225).
candidates.fix: Pass every catch through AppError(error)?.message. It keeps the server's text for 400/422 and row errors, so duplicate-row and 'has N logs' messages survive. One line per site.
candidates.benefit: Users get one plain message everywhere (e.g. 'Can't connect. Check your internet connection and try again.') instead of system jargon and status codes.
candidates.other_surfaces: Web mutations also show error.message (summary/log-workout/page.tsx:59) and Android shows e.message (LogWorkoutScreen.kt:202-204). Same gap but milder (no system strings); worth the same sweep.

candidates.problem: The cards read non-optional fields (AdminSummaryTab.swift:242-256). loadSummary only overwrites the reads that succeeded (ProgramContext+Analytics.swift:58-74), and switching program resets only totalWorkouts (ProgramPickerView.swift:459-466). So on a program's first open (no cache) the cards show 0, '0 hrs' or the previous program's numbers for up to 15 s. After a partial failure, the failed card keeps that value next to the stale banner, because analytics are hidden only on .failed (:168-170). Amendment A13 says a missing value shows '—'.
candidates.fix: Have loadSummary record which parts loaded for the current program, and render PlaceholderCard or '—' for the rest, including the .loading state with no cache.
candidates.benefit: The launch screen never shows invented zeros or another program's totals, matching Android and the kit rule.
candidates.other_surfaces: Android already does this (UnavailableCard '—', SummaryScreen.kt:147-188). Web shows '…' while loading.

candidates.problem: Errors are copied into a variable that is never rendered (AdminWorkoutTypesTab.swift:12/147, StandardWorkoutTypesTab.swift:11/135). Offline or a server error therefore looks like a brand-new program: 'Total workout types 0', 'N/A · No data' (WorkoutTypesCards.swift:56, 91-99) and empty charts. There is no Retry, no stale banner, no refetch on reconnect and no pull-to-refresh. The admin tab also never reloads its analytics on a later visit (it loads only when selectedMember == nil, :103-105), so new logs don't appear.
candidates.fix: Give the tab the same LoadState setup as Summary: .failed shows ErrorStateView with Retry, .stale shows the stale banner, refetch when back online, add .refreshable, and keep data on screen while reloading. Record it as a deliberate change to the admin-workout-types D-S1 ('faithful swallow').
candidates.benefit: Offline or slow states read as offline or slow, with Retry, instead of fake zeros, and the tab can be pulled to refresh (board W7 contract items 2 and 6).
candidates.other_surfaces: Android also swallows these errors (LifestyleScreen.kt:48). Web doesn't use the kit here, but TanStack retries twice, refetches on reconnect and shows '—' (lifestyle/page.tsx:218-230).

candidates.screen: Members tab (admin + standard) and its cards
candidates.problem: Errors are swallowed here too (StandardMembersTab.swift:9/163 is never rendered; the loaders only set the global errorMessage). A failure reads as 'No workouts logged yet.' (MemberOverviewPicker.swift:110, MemberCards.swift:137), '0 days' streaks (MemberCards.swift:69-70) or '0 members / No members to display' (MemberOverviewPicker.swift:399, 417). There is no pull-to-refresh or refetch on reconnect. The admin tab never reloads after the first selection (AdminMembersTab.swift:70-72), so a workout logged from Summary doesn't show until the member is picked again.
candidates.fix: Apply the Summary LoadState recipe: error view, stale banner, refetch on reconnect, .refreshable, and keep data while reloading. Board §10 rebuilds this tab as People with the W7 kit, so fold it into that work if People comes next; otherwise do it as a standalone pass.
candidates.benefit: Members show real error and offline states with Retry and stay current after logging, instead of claiming 'No workouts logged yet.'
candidates.other_surfaces: Android swallows these errors too (MembersScreen.kt:63). Web doesn't use the kit here, but TanStack retries and refetches on reconnect.

candidates.screen: Activity / member history / Lifestyle / Steps timelines; member Metrics, Workouts, Health detail
candidates.problem: All six screens start loads with `guard !isLoading else { return }` (ActivityTimelineDetailView.swift:231, LifestyleTimelineDetailView.swift:273, StepsTimelineDetailView.swift:240, MemberMetricsDetailView.swift:166, MemberRecentDetail.swift:388, MemberHealthDetail.swift:428), while every period, sort or filter change starts a new load (.task(id: period) :216; onChange MemberRecentDetail.swift:199-201). Tapping W→M→Y quickly drops the newest request, so the chart shows old bars under the new period's range label. The shared fields also leak back to the tab: MemberRecentDetail writes its filtered, sorted list into programContext.memberRecent, so after sorting by duration the Members-tab card previews the 3 shortest workouts (MemberCards.swift:136-143).
candidates.fix: Give each detail screen its own @State result tied to its request. Drop the isLoading guard, since task(id:) already cancels the old load, and ignore results from cancelled loads. MemberHealthDetail already keeps local `logs` (:103, :431).
candidates.benefit: The chart and list always match the chosen period or sort, and opening a detail no longer changes what the tab behind it shows.
candidates.other_surfaces: Android cancels correctly (LaunchedEffect(period.key), ActivityDetailScreen.kt:48) but shares memberRecent too (MemberRecentDetailScreen.kt:89), so it has the same preview bleed. Web keys queries per screen.

candidates.screen: Members/Lifestyle header buttons, Add workouts / Log health rows, Manage Roles
candidates.problem: The icon-only header buttons (GlassButton at AdminMembersTab.swift:39, StandardMembersTab.swift:46, WorkoutTypesCards.swift:31, StandardWorkoutTypesTab.swift:38) and the row ✕ buttons (AddWorkoutsDetailView.swift:228-234, AddDailyHealthDetailView.swift:217-223) have no accessibilityLabel; there is none anywhere in Features/Home/Tabs, Detail or ProgramManagement. The ✕ is about 22pt, and the Manage Roles chips are about 34pt tall (RoleManagementSection.swift:236-245).
candidates.fix: Give GlassButton a label parameter ('Invite member', 'View members', 'Workout types'). Label the ✕ 'Remove entry N' with a 44×44 tap area, and give the role chips a 44pt minimum height.
candidates.benefit: VoiceOver users can tell what the header buttons do, and small targets stop being mis-tapped.
candidates.other_surfaces: Android sets contentDescription on the header buttons (MembersScreen.kt:121, 187). Web not checked.

candidates.problem: Every delete and edit ends in a modal 'Deleted' or 'Saved' alert that must be dismissed (MemberRecentDetail.swift:171, 188-197, 420). The matching Health detail just reloads quietly (MemberHealthDetail.swift:447-455).
candidates.fix: Remove the two success alerts; the row disappearing or changing is the confirmation. Keep the failure alert.
candidates.benefit: One less tap per edit or delete, and the two log-detail screens behave the same.
candidates.other_surfaces: Web (members/workouts/page.tsx:140-158) and Android show no success dialog. iOS-only.

candidates.screen: Program tab: Switch Program / after Leave
candidates.problem: 'Switch Program' and the step after leaving a program push a second ProgramPickerView on top of the current program (AdminProgramTab.swift:51-54, ProgramCards.swift:129/262, StandardProgramTab.swift:79-88). The stack grows Picker → Home → Picker → Home with every switch, and each extra picker runs its own load and observers. The existing returnToMyPrograms mechanism (AdminHomeView.swift:61-63, ProgramPickerView.swift:92-102) already returns to the real list.
candidates.fix: Set programContext.returnToMyPrograms = true instead of pushing a new picker.
candidates.benefit: Switching programs returns to the single program list, as on web and Android, with no screens piling up behind it. Low but real benefit.
candidates.other_surfaces: Android navigates back via onSwitchProgram (ProgramScreen.kt:53, 111). Web routes to /programs.
